# DockMaximize transition arm rejects an idempotent second apply

## Context

PR #18017 resolved #18003 and merged as `4b7ed8a96a`. Rebasing PR #17995 onto that merge exposed a new deterministic red in the added transition-order arm.

## The Problem

The arm expects exactly:

`clear:start · clear:apply · apply:main-tabs`

Current `dev@4b7ed8a96a` can honestly produce:

`clear:start · clear:apply · apply:main-tabs · apply:main-tabs`

Both apply calls occur after the clear. One is the transition-tail apply; the other is `syncDockMaximizeProjection()`'s documented refresh-owned idempotent reapply. Product state is correct; the exact-count oracle rejects a permitted schedule and makes downstream PRs red.

## The Architectural Reality

The load-bearing contract is ordering, not cardinality:

- no apply may start before the held clear reaches `clear:apply`;
- at least one apply must follow;
- every later token must be the same idempotent `apply:main-tabs`.

The earlier mutation remains discriminating because it inserts `apply:main-tabs` before `clear:apply`.

## The Fix

Relax only the terminal cardinality assertion. Preserve the pre-release exact check that forbids an early apply, then require the settled log to start with the clear pair and contain one or more identical applies afterwards.

## Decision Record impact

`none` — test oracle correction; runtime source is untouched.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] One and two post-clear idempotent applies both satisfy the oracle.
- [ ] Any apply before `clear:apply` still fails.
- [ ] Any unexpected post-clear token still fails.
- [ ] Full DockMaximize component suite and a repeated targeted arm are green.

## Out of Scope

- Removing either production reapply path.
- Reopening resolved #18003.
- Changing maximize behavior or timing.
